title: This Pink Rock From the Sahara Is a 4.1-Billion-Year-Old Piece of Mars
description:
A rose-coloured rock found in Mali in 2022, Teghaza 001, is a Martian meteorite that formed at least 4.1 billion years ago, making it one of the three oldest Mars meteorites found on Earth.
Zircon crystals dated it; its minerals match Mars' cratered southern highlands (13 candidate sites), and it holds evidence that Mars' surface had water more than 4.1 billion years ago. The NASA JPL-led study is published in Science.
